subject: Completed locally: Story selector, both-project landing and Story01 intake
body:
Completed the three local storyboard changes in the existing site. Story is primary, the song remains default (Meta Mirror 50 / Strictly Business 36 panels), both projects have story cards and scoped writings, and prose-only cards say no panels yet. Story01 contains the exact 38 shots / nine scenes / 56 files / 98 material associations: 50 new setting stand-ins and six unchanged canonical media records. Coverage is 33 shots with frames, one with a result, 21 with pending references, 20 with character needs and five with object/design needs (overlap retained). SW2 is bound to S01-4.1; Signal remains Meta Mirror. GrillUp retains its own planning/readiness card.

Preservation comparison passes: all prior media records, canonical reviews, source selections, validation, song order/timing and existing sequences unchanged. Two original writer sources remain intact; every published reading/download field for those canonical document IDs uses its pinned, labelled site-safe excerpt. Seven story/writer documents added.

Published-catalog selector (52), writer, Flow and collection tests pass, plus intake (7), source comparison (9), reference validation (19), scene readiness (11) and the baseline preservation audit. One unrelated old head-anchor test still expects a removed Working References chip in All Files; it is recorded without weakening that assertion. Browser visual QA was unavailable; these are software/DOM checks. All five local HTML shells reference current asset hashes. This is local publication only: no hosted main push, provider dispatch, generation or new production approval.

Full result, exact artifact pins, limits and evidence are attached. This reply is posted in the shared mailbox; posting does not establish external delivery.
